title: Uniform free-coordinate projection
statement: Let $J$ be a subset of the coordinate indices $\\{1,\\ldots,n\\}$, and let $g$ be any real-valued function on sign assignments to $J$. Under a uniformly random sign assignment to all $n$ coordinates, the restriction to $J$ is uniform; consequently, the expected value of $g$ on that restriction equals the uniform expectation of $g$ over assignments to $J$.
hypotheses_covered: $J$ is a finite subset of the $n$ coordinate indices
$g$ is a real-valued function on sign assignments to $J$
